def: Adjusting a pass rate measured by an imperfect LLM judge using the judge’s true positive and true negative rates, measured on human-labeled data, to estimate the true pass rate.
practice: With pass as the positive class, the Rogan-Gladen estimate is (observed pass rate + TNR − 1) ÷ (TPR + TNR − 1); it becomes unstable as TPR + TNR nears 1, and its interval should include calibration-set uncertainty.
